text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a staged regional soft-launch for model-v3 (EU then NA). Need a concrete matrix: slices, eval method (shadow vs A/B), rollback automation, and customer opt paths. Quick ideas?

kevin: Suggest small region-by-region slices tied to routing weight + per-tenant windows. Example: region slice 5% -> 20% -> 60%. Keep each stage 12-48h depending on signal.

anita: For quality signal, prefer shadowing + sample A/B. Shadowing gives safety; sample A/B (10% of slice) gives actionable delta.

ryan: Infra: ensure instance priming before traffic. We should schedule a 30m warmup where traffic is mirrored but not counted. Also pre-warm KV cache to avoid p95 spikes.

oliver: Define clear automatic rollback rules. My proposal: automated pause if p95 latency increases >25% for 15m OR error rate +0.75% absolute for 10m. For regressions, trigger if eval delta >4 points on our composite metric.

jamal: Sales note: enterprise customers want opt-out and scheduled maintenance windows. We should support a per-tenant hold until they manually opt in. That needs a console switch + email opt-in flow.

sasha: Compliance: keep EU logs/residency local. Also need audit entries for flag changes and rollbacks.

kevin: I'll sketch a flag matrix we can drop into Console.

```yaml
flags:
  model_v3_regional_soft_launch:
    stages:
      - name: eu_stage_1
        weight: 5%
        duration: 12h
        eval: shadow + sample_ab_10%
      - name: eu_stage_2
        weight: 20%
        duration: 24h
        eval: full_canary
      - name: eu_stage_3
        weight: 60%
        duration: 48h
        eval: health_metrics
    fallbacks:
      - target: model_v2_q8
        immediate: true
    controls:
      - per_tenant_hold: true
      - manual_kill_switch: true
      - audit_logging: enabled
```

anita: Add cost gate: if token cost per-request increases > 35% sustained over a stage -> pause. Also a quantized fallback option for cost-sensitive tenants.

ryan: Capacity plan: +30% node buffer in region, auto-scale threshold at 70% CPU or 60% GPU mem. Quickscale if queue latency >40ms for 5m.

oliver: Who owns automated rollback? Need an oncall runbook + incident playbook entry. If automation pauses, page SRE and page product lead.

maria: Owners? Kevin (product flags/schedule), Anita (runtime cost + quantized fallback), Ryan (infra capacity), Oliver (oncall/runbook), Jamal (customer communications), Sasha (audit/compliance).

jamal: Draft customer comms: short notice, opt-in link, expected timelines, rollback SLA (we can revert per-tenant within 5m).

kevin: One more: telemetry retention for canary must be higher for 2 weeks for debugging. Increase retention for canary traces.

deploy-bot: Warmup job scheduled: model-v3-eu-mirror @ 2025-04-02T08:00Z (30m). Audit token: abcd-ef01

maria: Good. Next steps: Kevin to publish flag matrix PR, Anita & Ryan to validate warmup scripts, Oliver to draft runbook. Reconvene Tue AM for signoff.
